requests.prompt:
A 4x4 grid of 16 chibi sticker expressions on a clean white background, separated by thin grid borders. Same character in all 16 cells: a Q-version anime JK schoolgirl mascot with warm dark-brown hair, low twin ponytails with fluffy outward-flipped ends, one lively ahoge on top, a red bow hair accessory on the viewer's right side, large glossy purple eyes with pink-purple highlights, soft pink cheek blush, small nose, elastic cartoon mouth. Wearing a dark navy JK blazer with a white shirt underneath, red bow tie at the collar, dark pleated skirt (only when full body). ONE small circular chest pin badge with red outer ring and blue center (the mini-program logo) is placed on the blazer chest in EVERY cell. Do NOT place the logo on hair accessories, hats, background, props or anywhere else. Upper-body composition by default; only show full body when the gag needs body or leg action. Crisp chibi linework, soft pastel cel shading, strong silhouette, sticker-friendly, readable at chat-sticker scale.

The 16 cells in order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom:

Row 1: 1) Early 8am class: face planted on a desk, one dead-fish eye barely open, dark eyebags, drool string, tiny soul floating out of her head. 2) Shocked: blank white-circle eyes, mouth wide open in a perfect O, anime impact lines around the head, stiff pose. 3) Crying meltdown: huge water-stream tears gushing from squeezed-shut eyes, wailing mouth, both hands clutching her head. 4) Rage: pop-vein anger marks on temple, sharp-tooth growl, fire aura behind the head, clenched fists raised.

Row 2: 5) Checking grades: trembling hands holding a phone, blank pale face, cold blue-gray shadow, sweat drops, a tiny soul leaving the body, white-circle eyes. 6) Snatched the class: wild starry eyes, both fists pumped in the air, villainous victorious grin with a tiny fang, confetti and sparkle effects. 7) Failed to grab the course: cracked-screen stunned face, gray aura, dead-fish eyes, phone slipping from hand, sweat drops. 8) Thesis week: spiral dizzy eyes, slightly frazzled hair with one bent ahoge, buried in a pile of crumpled papers, pen still in hand, dark eyebags.

Row 3: 9) Food frenzy: cheeks stuffed full, sparkling eyes, shameless happy expression, snack crumbs flying, tiny tongue out, star effects. 10) Lying flat / giving up: FULL BODY, flattened like a pancake on the ground, limbs spread out, tiny ghost floating up out of the body, blank dot eyes, limp. 11) Social anxiety: hiding inside a cardboard box, only two peeking eyes visible from a slit, bashful vibe, one sweat drop. 12) Eating melon / watching drama: leaning forward, holding a watermelon slice, half-lidded smug narrow eyes, tiny smirk, gossipy energy.

Row 4: 13) Deadline panic: full body leaning over a glowing laptop, sweat flying, small flames behind, frantic typing hands, wide panicked eyes, keyboard sparks. 14) Received red packet: starry gleaming eyes, both hands cupped together, sparkle effect, cheeks slightly pink, big smile. 15) Frozen in ice: FULL BODY, completely frozen inside a translucent blue ice cube block with frost sparkles, only one confused eye peeking, icicles. 16) Gave up / surrendered: hands raised in surrender, dead-fish eyes, flat mouth, soft blue-gray shadow, drooping ahoge, tiny ghost leaving body.

Strict requirements: identical character design across all 16 cells, identical small chest pin badge in all 16 cells (no bigger, no smaller, no duplicated, no removed), consistent hair color (warm dark brown, NOT silver, NOT gray, NOT blue), consistent uniform. No text on stickers. Crisp 2D anime sticker art, vibrant colors, clean lines, each cell readable on its own.
